attributes.axis_log: PREMISE REFUTED FIRST: the lane's standing 'SetItem is 1296/1306, 10 instructions SHORT' is FALSE as of this measurement -- probe.py reads T1306/O1306, instruction-count EXACT. There is no deficit to side-decompose; the 10-instruction figure predates attempt.items-c-defakematch-tupass.20260830.v2, which already records 1306/1306. AXIS 1 (slot map, WON): slotdiff frame 256/256 but 4T/4O exclusive slots -- T{48,52,76,108} vs O{60,64,72,104}. Identifying the objects from the aligned view (sprintf(child_name,fmt,name) gives addi r3,r1,76 = child_name and addi r5,r1,108 = name) showed child_name[32] and name[36] each 4 bytes LOW and the two bit-trick-abs temps (stfs/lwz/clrlwi/stw/lfs at 0x23c-0x264, i.e. the inner-block f32 z/x) 12 bytes HIGH. 8-byte ruler (stack_pad 4->12) REGRESSED real 528->616 and grew the frame 256->264, but proved the mechanism in one build: everything above the pad moved +8, the temps below did not move, so the block is bottom-anchored on the temp block. That made the residual TWO canceling errors, which is why every prior single-variable pass missed it: the inner-block u8 abs_pad[24] sits BELOW the abs temps and was 12 bytes too big, while the function-scope u8 stack_pad[4] was 16 bytes too small, and the two errors cancel in the frame size (both sides read 256). JOINT probe (abs_pad 24->12 AND stack_pad 4->20, net +4 which exactly absorbs the 4-byte alignment pad in front of the 8-byte f64 temp at 144): SLOT MAP IDENTICAL, real 528->500, frame held at 256. Committed e17feda63. AXIS 2 (visrad clamp, WON): target @204-218 is the ternary diamond (lfs radius, lfs height, fcmpo, ble to the false arm, the empty true arm's own b to the merge, fmr) while ours was the negated guard (extra fmr f2,f0 then bgt). Rewrote the goto-based clamp as (f64)(radius > height ? radius : height) with the pass-through value written first per the law's precondition (2): region became shape-exact, real 500->492, multiset 22t->18t. Gate flagged IMPROVED-CARRIER; fresh full-report fuzzy 97.5337->97.7297 CONFIRMED the keep. Committed 809c4e533. AXIS 3 (forward branch-pair guards, NEGATIVE): the two keyring/low-item search loops each show target ['bne'->increment, 'b'->found] against our single fused ['beq'->found]. Both branches are FORWARD, so claim.law.empty-block-branch-pair-splits-forward-vs-backedge says the shape is source-reachable via 'a guard whose body is a SINGLE control transfer'. Rewrote both from `if (subtype > 0 && subtype != body->subtype) { continue; } goto found;` to `if (subtype <= 0 || subtype == body->subtype) { goto found; }`: byte-for-byte NEUTRAL, every --ops cluster and the whole multiset unchanged, so MWCC canonicalizes the two spellings. Discarded via git (probe --revert cannot be used to drop a NEUTRAL: neutral states bank too). AXIS 4 (entry schedule, NEGATIVE): target materializes gWorldInfo@ha/@lo into ONE register in place (lis r3 / addi r3,r3,@lo / addi r22,r3,104) whereas ours homes the @lo into a different register (lis r7 ... addi r3,r7,@lo / addi r19,r3,104). Moving the infos/info_base declarations ahead of strings left the entry region shape completely unchanged (NEUTRAL, bytes changed, no cluster moved). This is the recorded addrlo home-copy class; discarded via git and NOT re-probed.
